body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Paris, France. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 3 km. It starts at Entrance to the Catacombs of Paris, 1 Avenue du Colonel Henri Rol-Tanguy. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Skip-the-line timed entry ticket to the Paris Catacombs. There is no live guide: the tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone. WeGoTrip names Sergio as the tour's author.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> This self-guided audio tour includes your ticket to the Catacombs of Paris and immerses you in the shadowy underworld of over 6 million remains before venturing through the bohemian heart of Montparnasse.
>
> The route begins at the Catacombs entrance on Avenue du Colonel Henri Rol-Tanguy, where you descend 20 meters underground to explore the ossuary created in the late 18th century from overflowing city cemeteries. Cherish chilling encounters with neatly stacked bones in cool, slippery tunnels.
>
> Emerging 700 meters away, you head to Montparnasse Cemetery to see graves of icons like Guy de Maupassant, Serge Gainsbourg, and Jean-Paul Sartre with Simone de Beauvoir. Stroll Boulevard du Montparnasse past legendary cafés La Rotonde and Le Select, frequented by Hemingway, Picasso, and Modigliani, then pass Bobino music hall, ending at the 200-meter Montparnasse Tower for panoramic city views. Dive into poignant stories at celebrity tombs, the electric buzz of artist haunts with outdoor tables, and breathtaking vistas of the Eiffel Tower and Notre-Dame from the tower's open-air terrace.
